name: Ljubovnaja fantazija: Vyzhivshaja
source:
In the near future, the world has been attacked by an unknown virus and natural disasters. You are one of the few who survived. But are you ready for the twists and turns of fate and new meetings that lie ahead of you?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231229083908/https://stacystorygames.itch.io/love-fantasy-survival-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
